source.name: Technician
source.originalDescription: After this Pokémon uses a move, the next auto attack will deal two consecutive auto attacks instead. The second of these deals decreased damage. Technician lasts 5s and has no internal cooldown. After using a move, the next basic attack will change to deal 2 attacks instead. The second attack deals reduced damage.

source.name: Green Illusion Dive
source.originalDescription: Target an enemy, slashing through them dealing an initial hit of damage and creating 5 copies a set distance away. Copies deal damage to enemies they make contact with and apply a mark to them for 5s. After 5s, the copies return to Scyther, dealing damage to enemies they make contact with and healing Scyther for each hit. This move may be used again within 5s of activating as a dash in a designated direction dealing damage to enemies hit. The copies then dash to the end location of the user's dash. If a copy makes contact with an enemy while returning to Scyther, the copy deals damage to that enemy and disappears. If a marked enemy is knocked out, all of Scyther's move cooldowns are reset. Subsequent copies hitting the same target deal 70% reduced damage. Buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Green Illusion Dive は 受けるダメージを軽減する、HPを回復する、シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ、分身、コピー、身代わりなどを生成する。
